name: add_plane
description: Create a flat 2-sided plane (billboard) — the building block of pixel VFX (flames, energy sheets, slashes, motion trails) and for thin details (fins, leaves, paper). It is a zero-depth cube whose two large faces carry the texture; pair it with a VFX texture set to render_sides 'double'. `crossed:true` makes an X of two perpendicular planes for a volumetric particle look. Parent it to a bone to animate it.

crossed.description: Add a second perpendicular plane (volumetric particle).

facing.description: Axis the plane faces (default 'z' = faces ±Z; 'y' = flat horizontal).

from.description: Lower corner [x,y,z] (one corner of the plane).

parent.description: uuid or name of the parent bone/group.

texture.description: Texture to apply (defaults to the project default).
